# BSV Snakebite Awareness Campaign

> India's National Snakebite Awareness Initiative by Bharat Serums and Vaccines Limited. The campaign promotes evidence-based snakebite first aid, immediate hospital treatment, awareness, and healthcare-worker training.

## Public website

- [Home](https://snakebite-info.bsvgroup.com/): Campaign overview and emergency snakebite guidance.
- [Training](https://snakebite-info.bsvgroup.com/training): Healthcare-worker training resources.
- [KOL Program](https://snakebite-info.bsvgroup.com/kol-program): Clinical expert engagement.
- [Mass Media](https://snakebite-info.bsvgroup.com/mass-media): PR, radio, and influencer activity.
- [On-Ground Activations](https://snakebite-info.bsvgroup.com/onground): Community outreach activity.
- [Impact Stories](https://snakebite-info.bsvgroup.com/impact-stories): Campaign impact stories.
- [Videos](https://snakebite-info.bsvgroup.com/videos): Campaign films and videos.
- [Gallery](https://snakebite-info.bsvgroup.com/gallery): Campaign image gallery.
- [Posters and Brochures](https://snakebite-info.bsvgroup.com/brochures): Downloadable awareness materials.
- [NGO Network](https://snakebite-info.bsvgroup.com/ngo-network): Partner network information.

## Important guidance

- Treat every snakebite as a medical emergency.
- Do not use home remedies, tourniquets, cutting, or suction.
- Seek immediate care at the nearest hospital.
- Website content is for public awareness and does not replace professional medical advice.
